description:
Early Support and positive vibes:

Mike Salta/Music For Dreams - What a stunning surprise.This album is already a contender for a best of the year... a cornucopia of
supreme soundscapes and unique vibes. Compositions
are pure brilliance and the mighty fine blend of acoustics
and electronics delivers a sincere and authentic output....will be with me all summer. Full support.

Simon Lee/Faze Action - Lovely Album, quality all the way, loving the song writing on Flame On -). Will be playing this in the summer months for sure.

Woolfy/US - 'Wonderful production, wonderful album. Hard to choose
a favourite!'

Alice Palace/Pikes, Ibiza - 'Lovely album this, already looking fwd to listening through again.'

Phil Mison/Cantoma/Ambala - 'Liking this . Will be playing over the summer, full support.' 

Dream Chimney - 'Really nice tracks on this album, love it!' 

Pete Herbert/MFSP - 'Love the album, solid all the way, and have played
almost every track on the show over the last few weeks.'

Big shout out to Pete Herbert for his help/support/advice and to Des, Finn, Oscar & CJ for their outstanding contributions.

Calabra are London based DJ Toni Rossano and producer Neil Simons.

Following on from their well received debut, the International Feel released 'Mazzara Return EP', Calabra present their debut album, No FM. 

The same no holds barred, borderless approach and philosophy remains central with the complete work designed to be a listener's journey evoking both pool-side down time and dancing in equal measures. 

No FM is performed and produced by the duo and features return collaborator Des Morgan's inimitable percussion, smouldering saxophone from Finn Peters, debut vocals from Ciccione Jones and uplifting acoustic guitars from musician/producer Oscar Simons.

To fullfill the aspired tags 'balearic, balearicbeat, yacht rock and nu-disco' artists including Sierra Maestra, Yaw Sarpong, Steely Dan, Sabres of Paradise, Roxy Music, Home, Ferdi Schuster and Neumayer Station have informed the album.
